name: Balor
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage, and flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried ignite.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The balor makes one Lightning Sword attack and one Whip attack.

actions.name: Lightning Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Whip
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 30 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) Force damage, and the target is pulled up to 25 feet straight toward the balor if it is a Huge or smaller creature.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The balor magically teleports itself, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

description: Balors are massive, flame-wreathed demon lords who lead the Abyss's armies in the Blood War, wielding a lightning-wreathed sword and a lashing fire whip, and detonating in a final blast of hellfire when finally slain.
